{"notes": "VISIT 1 (1:45): Table empty. Maya set a clear replan at 1:15 (start at the nose, two strokes crossing at the tail neck, roles assigned) but I didn't see her confirm it reached Priya. Priya flagged that her pad still showed the old start and was waiting on a fix. Tom was assigned to clear the old tail and I saw no action. Leo was unseen and had no assigned role.

VISIT 2 (5:30): The picture shows the whole fish built and connected to START: both strokes run from the nose and cross at the tail neck, and every domino is dark. So the replan worked and the team recovered. I don't know who placed which domino, so I'm crediting outcomes, not individuals.

Leo: Checked the lower join and crossing at 5:15 and reported accurately. The picture matches his claim that everything is connected, including the extra domino at the lower join, which is also connected and harmless. He was honest about the flaw instead of hiding it and called a hands-off rule on the crossing. Tom credited his nudge. Good collaboration, with some leadership and impact shown. Still unclear what he physically built.

Tom: Reported status at 5:00 (bottom line through the crossing to the upper tip), thanked Leo, and stayed off the join to avoid breaking it. That is good collaboration and discipline. I still don't know whether he cleared the old tail.

Maya: Not seen this visit. Her plan seems to have held up, but I have no evidence of follow-up or hands-on work. Ask her.

Priya: Not seen this visit. Ask whether the pad mismatch got fixed and what she traced.

Review: ask all four privately who built what and what the replan cost."}
